series.name: Sitting at the Feet of Rabbi Jesus

sermon.centralTheme: Jesus' model prayer teaches His disciples to approach God as Father, honor His name and will, depend upon Him for daily provision and forgiveness, and seek His protection from evil.
sermon.proposition: Jesus' model prayer provides a pattern for a God-centered life of prayer.
sermon.summary: This legacy sermon studies Matthew 6:5-15 in light of Jewish prayer practices and terminology. It discusses tefillin, the Shema, the Amidah, Jesus' address to 'Our Father,' hallowing God's name, God's kingdom and will, daily bread, forgiveness, and deliverance from evil. The sermon compares elements of Jesus' teaching with Jewish prayer customs while emphasizing dependence upon God, repentance, forgiveness, and protection from Satan.
